LONGINES LEGEND DIVER

Originally designed for underwater exploration, the Longines Legend Diver is equally at home on land or underwater. With its timeless design and cutting-edge performance, it has been a true icon of watchmaking since 1959. At first glance, it is distinctive because of its two crowns and internal rotating bezel. Invented by Longines, the position of the bezel inside the case protects it from accidental manipulation and shocks that could alter its settings. These true tool watches are powered by exclusive Longines calibres equipped with a silicon balance-spring. The collection is available in a range of sizes, materials and colours.

ULTRA‑CHRON

In 1968, Longines launched the Ultra-Chron Diver, the first dive watch equipped with a high-frequency movement. At the time, Longines had already established itself as a pioneer in high-frequency technology. As early as 1910, the winged hourglass brand created the first high-frequency timekeeping device capable of measuring 1/10th of a second. In 1959, Longines developed the first high-beat movement for a wristwatch, an observatory chronometer that set new records in terms of accuracy. The new Ultra-Chron is inspired by the aesthetic codes and professional diving features of the 1968 model. These chronometer-certified watches are powered by an exclusive Longines calibre equipped with a silicon balance-spring and resistant to magnetic fields.

ULTRA‑CHRON

In 1968, Longines launched the Ultra-Chron Diver, the first dive watch equipped with a high-frequency movement. At the time, Longines had already established itself as a pioneer in high-frequency technology. As early as 1910, the winged hourglass brand created the first high-frequency timekeeping device capable of measuring 1/10th of a second. In 1959, Longines developed the first high-beat movement for a wristwatch, an observatory chronometer that set new records in terms of accuracy. The new Ultra-Chron is inspired by the aesthetic codes and professional diving features of the 1968 model. These chronometer-certified watches are powered by an exclusive Longines calibre equipped with a silicon balance-spring and resistant to magnetic fields.

LONGINES PILOT MAJETEK

On 1 April 1935, Longines registered the Pilot Majetek model with the International Bureau of Industrial Property in Bern, Switzerland. Initially designed for aviators, this timepiece has gradually won over a wider public looking for a reliable, robust and precise watch. Almost a century later, the brand has revived this unique pilot's watch with completely revised technical and ergonomic features. A major technical challenge, its bidirectional fluted bezel with internal “starting time indicator”, mounted on a cushion-shaped case, asserts its innovative character and recalls the 1935 model that inspired it. These chronometer-certified watches are powered by an exclusive Longines calibre equipped with a silicon balance-spring and resistant to magnetic fields.

LONGINES LEGEND DIVER

Originally designed for underwater exploration, the Longines Legend Diver is equally at home on land or underwater. With its timeless design and cutting-edge performance, it has been a true icon of watchmaking since 1959. At first glance, it is distinctive because of its two crowns and internal rotating bezel. Invented by Longines, the position of the bezel inside the case protects it from accidental manipulation and shocks that could alter its settings. These true tool watches are powered by exclusive Longines calibres equipped with a silicon balance-spring. The collection is available in a range of sizes, materials and colours.

ULTRA‑CHRON

In 1968, Longines launched the Ultra-Chron Diver, the first dive watch equipped with a high-frequency movement. At the time, Longines had already established itself as a pioneer in high-frequency technology. As early as 1910, the winged hourglass brand created the first high-frequency timekeeping device capable of measuring 1/10th of a second. In 1959, Longines developed the first high-beat movement for a wristwatch, an observatory chronometer that set new records in terms of accuracy. The new Ultra-Chron is inspired by the aesthetic codes and professional diving features of the 1968 model. These chronometer-certified watches are powered by an exclusive Longines calibre equipped with a silicon balance-spring and resistant to magnetic fields.

THE LONGINES AVIGATION

For almost a century, Longines has been closely associated with the world of aviation. The brand has produced a large number of pilots' watches and chronographs, airborne instruments and other navigational instruments that have accompanied the development of civil and military aviation. Capturing the spirit of the pilots' watches of the early 20th century, Longines brings this fascinating history back to life with iconic models such as the Longines Pilot Majetek, the Longines Avigation BigEye, the Longines Weems Second-Setting Watch or the Lindbergh Hour Angle Watch. These timepieces incorporate the latest watchmaking technology and are available in a range of sizes, materials and colours.

LONGINES LEGEND DIVER

Originally designed for underwater exploration, the Longines Legend Diver is equally at home on land or underwater. With its timeless design and cutting-edge performance, it has been a true icon of watchmaking since 1959. At first glance, it is distinctive because of its two crowns and internal rotating bezel. Invented by Longines, the position of the bezel inside the case protects it from accidental manipulation and shocks that could alter its settings. These true tool watches are powered by exclusive Longines calibres equipped with a silicon balance-spring. The collection is available in a range of sizes, materials and colours.

THE LONGINES AVIGATION

For almost a century, Longines has been closely associated with the world of aviation. The brand has produced a large number of pilots' watches and chronographs, airborne instruments and other navigational instruments that have accompanied the development of civil and military aviation. Capturing the spirit of the pilots' watches of the early 20th century, Longines brings this fascinating history back to life with iconic models such as the Longines Pilot Majetek, the Longines Avigation BigEye, the Longines Weems Second-Setting Watch or the Lindbergh Hour Angle Watch. These timepieces incorporate the latest watchmaking technology and are available in a range of sizes, materials and colours.
